name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Closed out the remaining lightly-examined areas from the last few bug-sweep passes (PlexApiClient.cs and a few configPage.html UI elements) - the Plex client and the config page's double-init/handler-attach guards both checked out correctly wired on close review, no changes needed there. Found and fixed one real gap: TailscaleService.InstallAsync's own doc comment says it must only be called once CheckEnvironmentAsync confirms this host can actually run Tailscale (Linux, root, /dev/net/tun present) - but its only caller, the Setup/Tailscale/Install endpoint, never did that check. The config page's Install button is disabled based on it client-side, but starts enabled by default until that async check resolves, and a direct API call skips the UI entirely - so nothing server-side ever stopped curl|sh from running unconditionally on a host that can't actually use the result. The endpoint now runs the same environment check the UI already relies on before installing. 301 tests, all green, run 2x.
